facts.value: Unconditionally calls Fighter_ChangeMotionState for ftCo_MS_CaptureWaitKoopa with Ft_MF_None, anim_start=0, anim_speed=1, anim_blend=0 and NULL animation source. It then installs ftCo_800DB464 in accessory1_cb and writes x1A6A=0x1FF through ftCommon_8007E2F4. The active common table selects ftCo_SM_None (-1), so the transition initializes cur_anim_frame to -1 and takes the no-animation cleanup path rather than starting a wait clip at frame zero. The transition clears accessory1_cb before this entry reinstalls it. Ground CaptureDamageKoopa Anim selects this entry on animation completion and returns before timer processing in that invocation. The entry itself neither initializes grab_timer nor checks ground_or_air.
facts.rationale: Replaces an animation-playback interpretation with exact entry, table and caller semantics.

evidence.why: Frame initialization, cleanup and callback reset.

facts.value: Obtains Fighter from the captured object's Fighter_GObj pointer and passes that object to ftCo_800BC458, which updates grab_timer and the mash result using associated-captor values. It then reads the updated grab_timer. If grab_timer <= 0, it passes fp->victim_gobj (the captor in this relationship) and 0 to ftCo_800DA698, negates the captive's facing_dir and passes the original object to ftCo_CaptureCut_Enter. Otherwise, including when the comparison is unordered for NaN, it passes the original object to ftCo_800BC4A8. It performs no local allocation, deallocation or null validation.
facts.rationale: Corrects pointer-role ambiguity and incomplete positive-only continuation description.

facts.value: Every invocation first performs decrement/mash processing through ftCo_800BC458, then tests the resulting grab_timer <= 0. True enters CatchCut on the captor with optional captive CaptureCut disabled, reverses the captive's facing and enters CaptureCut on that captive. False calls ftCo_800BC4A8 for continued capture adjustment. At the source comparison, signed zeros, negative finite values and negative infinity release; positive finite values, positive infinity and NaN continue. There is no local clamp, finite check, animation-completion guard or null check. Air Anim delegates unchanged to this implementation.
facts.rationale: Records exact post-update boundary, exceptional-value behavior and paired release ordering.

evidence.why: Optional release suppressed by false argument.
Stores the captor pointer in the captive.

facts.value: The two entries select ground/air capture-wait states, install the same position accessory callback after motion transition and set x1A6A=0x1FF. Shared Anim passes the captured object through decrement/mash processing and tests the updated grab_timer <= 0. On true, victim_gobj identifies the captor passed to ftCo_800DA698; the captive's facing is negated before its CaptureCut entry unlinks the pair. Otherwise the object reaches ftCo_800BC4A8, including for NaN. Air Anim forwards unchanged; the six IASA/Phys/Coll bodies do not consume their parameters.
facts.rationale: Complete TU flow with explicit pointer roles and comparison ordering.

evidence.why: Pair unlinking clears both relationship pointers.

facts.value: Ground and air wait states share one Anim implementation: update decrement/mash state, then release the associated captor through CatchCut and the facing-reversed captive through CaptureCut when the resulting timer compares <= 0; otherwise continue capture adjustment. NaN takes continuation. Air adds no local logic and all six IASA/Phys/Coll callbacks are empty. Empty IASA does not disable mash input through Anim, and empty Phys does not disable positional maintenance through accessory1_cb. Both active wait table entries select ftCo_SM_None rather than a dedicated wait clip. These are local callback-suite properties, not exclusive control over every captor-side release or engine update.
facts.rationale: Preserves the shared-state design while removing overly broad no-input/no-motion and playing-animation interpretations.

evidence.why: Shared branch, setup and empty phases.
